rated_messages.input_message: Each time you let an urge pass without smoking, you break the old habit a bit more.
Seeing other people smoke is a predictable and unavoidable trigger. Take 5 slow, deep breaths and remind yourself that the urge will pass and that you do not need to smoke.
Notice how stress and anxiety may pull you and make you want to smoke. Just notice this. You can choose to just notice and not smoke.
As smokers are usually with you in this location, it's really important that you're not with them when they smoke. Consider avoiding this place if possible until things settle down.
It's normal to have some doubts during a quit attempt. Keep your quit reasons on hand to remind yourself if ever you feel uncertain or undecided.
Just because letting an urge pass isn't easy, doesn't mean that you can't do it. Try it, you might surprise yourself.
Are you feeling down because you are thinking of smoking? It's really important to be kind to yourself, and to make sure you give yourself praise too!
This craving is just an event. A game. It will pass. The game gets easier the more you let your urge pass without smoking. But, it gets harder every time you give in to the urge and smoke.
If this situation becomes stressful for you, make an excuse to leave for a few minutes. If this doesn't help, it might be better to just leave early.
